name: veterinary_clinic_system_061_new_patient_enrollment
instruction: Complete the new-patient intake bundle under the episode batch code. The patient is 'Maple Syrup', a female spayed Holland Lop rabbit (species 'exotic'), born 2023-02-14, 1.8 kg, owned by owner id 3 (Ingrid Larsson) at location 1. Use the ISO 11784 15-digit microchip id 985112900001234. Create the patient record with status 'active', alerts [], dob at midnight UTC, and created_at at the episode timestamp. Then book a wellness exam on the episode date, 09:00–09:30, in Exam 2 at location 1, with the location-1 veterinarian whose specialties include 'exotics' (resolve this provider from the providers table; do not hardcode the id). Create a draft billing_estimates row for this patient/owner using the location-1 fee-schedule WELL-EXAM item, estimate_number 'EST-NP-<batch_code>', status 'draft', created_date and expires_date set to the episode date, and total_amount equal to the schedule price. Push a welcome communications row to owner id 3 with subject 'Welcome — Maple Syrup (<batch_code>)' and a body that includes the appointment date/time, the resolved provider name, and the exact estimate total. Append an audit_log row {actor: 'Dana Whitaker', actor_role: 'org_admin', action: 'PATIENT_ENROLLED', target_collection: 'patients', target_id: <new patient id>, details: 'New patient intake <batch_code>: Maple Syrup for owner 3.', occurred_at: episode timestamp}. The whole bundle must be idempotent so a re-run does not create duplicate records.
_par_steps_note: placeholder -- measure via live gold run in QC session
_max_steps_note: placeholder -- set to roughly par_steps * 1.5 after live measurement

success_criteria.summary: Exactly one new patient with the given exact fields and a 15-digit microchip. Exactly one appointment on the episode date 09:00-09:30 Exam 2 with the location-1 exotics provider. Exactly one draft estimate for the new patient/owner with the WELL-EXAM line item and price drawn from the location-1 fee schedule. Exactly one welcome communications row and one PATIENT_ENROLLED audit_log row. All counts are verified via Python and SQL dual paths where applicable. No other collections are modified.

checks.expect: one new row per collection with exact fields, provider resolved from live data, price from fee schedule
estimate count and total recomputed via SQL and Python

hazards: microchip-format decoy: every one of the 300 existing patients has a non-compliant microchip (299 are exactly 12 digits, e.g., id 1 '985112100000'; id 30 has 11 digits '98511232965'). The new patient must use the explicit 15-digit id 985112900001234; a 12-digit chip fails ISO 11784 verification.

provider resolution hazard: only one location-1 veterinarian has 'exotics' in specialties (provider id 2, Dr. Marcus Chen). Booking with any other provider or room/time fails the appointment constraints.
existing-patient collision: owner 3 already has a transferred patient id 27 (Poppy, feline) and active patients; the new rabbit must be a new row, not an update or reactivation.
fee-schedule lookup: the WELL-EXAM price must be read from the location-1 fee_schedules.items array, not hardcoded or guessed.
idempotency: the appointment, estimate, communications, and audit rows must be keyed by the batch code so a re-run does not duplicate them.

uniqueness_report.differentiation_note: Multi-step new-patient bundle that requires resolving a provider by specialty, looking up a fee-schedule price, booking a constrained appointment slot, and producing cross-collection audit/communication records. The microchip format check and idempotency-by-batch separate it from simple create tasks.
